parameters.name: DateType
parameters.description: Filter time type. Supports filtering by the last 7 days, the last 30 days, the last half year, or custom time ranges.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mssp get-susp-event-summary --date-type month --start-date 1729478485000 --end-date 1732156885986 --susp-event-source SUSP_EVENT --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mssp GetSuspEventSummary --region cn-hangzhou --StartDate 1729478485000 --SuspEventSource SUSP_EVENT --DateType month --EndDate 1732156885986
